description: On-chain agent coordination protocol on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32). This lab run initialised the protocol config PDA (seeds ["protocol"]) with a two-of-three lab multisig after checking ProgramData. The hosted IDL covers that verified initialize_protocol instruction only.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/agenc-protocol fork. The lab changed declare_id / Anchor.toml to a new Sol.College devnet program (not the upstream mainnet id) and commented solana_version so lab builds do not trigger solana-install. The hosted IDL is a minimal hand-derived subset confirmed by the verifying initialize_protocol transaction. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize_protocol)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agenc-protocol/
QA: devnet proof of initialize_protocol and InvalidDisputeThreshold; register_agent rejected with ProtocolPaused
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise register_agent (and a simple task flow) against the initialised lab protocol config
